## Standard

<a id="GitHubRepositoryApi"></a>

### GitHub's API for a repository

`GitHubRepositoryApi` · `src/repository.ts:48`

The calls and the words that set a repository: its merge methods and automatic merges, its rulesets (a branch, the rules that protect it: no deletion, no rewriting, a pull request, the status checks required), its pages built by a workflow.

Source: GitHub REST API: Repositories (Update a repository), Rules (Create, Get and Update a repository ruleset), Pages (Create a GitHub Pages site, build_type workflow); GitHub CLI manual: gh api (--method, --input, --jq, -f) · `https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/rules`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `program` | `gh` | GitHub's command line, with the token of the person who runs it |
| `api` | `api` | Calls GitHub's API |
| `method` | `--method` | The method of the call |
| `patch` | `PATCH` | Changes what it names |
| `post` | `POST` | Creates |
| `put` | `PUT` | Replaces |
| `input` | `--input` | The body of the call, read from a file |
| `standardInput` | `-` | As a file: what the command is given |
| `repos` | `repos/` | Before the repository, owner/name |
| `rulesets` | `/rulesets` | After it: its rulesets |
| `branchRules` | `/rules/branches/` | After it, before a branch: the rules in force on the branch |
| `pages` | `/pages` | After it: its pages |
| `separator` | `/` | Between the steps of a path |

## Vocabulary

<a id="MergeMethods"></a>

### How GitHub merges a pull request

`MergeMethods` · `src/repository.ts:21`

A merge commit keeps each commit of the branch (a generation is a commit); squashed, the branch is one commit; rebased, its commits are replayed on the main branch.

| Word | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `merge` | A merge commit: each commit of the branch kept |
| `squash` | One commit for the branch |
| `rebase` | Each commit replayed on the main branch |
